title: Position Air Purifier in Central Breathing Zone, Away From Corners
appliesWhen: Operating any portable HEPA room air cleaner

sources.title: Air distribution and placement optimization for portable air cleaners

effectModel: Avoids corner air stagnation and short-circuiting, increasing effective room air mixing efficiency by ~25%.

title: Build a Corsi-Rosenthal Box Air Cleaner
appliesWhen: High room volume requiring high CADR on an economical budget

sources.title: Characterizing the performance of Corsi-Rosenthal boxes
sources.organisation: UC Davis / Aerosol Science and Technology

effectModel: Delivers CADR > 400 m³/h at ~70% lower upfront equipment cost than commercial multi-stage purifiers.

title: Wet Mop Floors Instead of Dry Brooming (Jhadu)

sources.title: Human activities and dust resuspension rates in residential indoor environments

effectModel: Prevents resuspension of 5,000 µg/h of fine particulate matter, lead, and road dust settled on floor surfaces.

title: Close Kitchen Door and Engage Exhaust During Cooking
appliesWhen: Frying, grilling, or high-temperature oil cooking

sources.title: Cooking-generated particles in residential indoor environments

effectModel: Creates negative pressure in the kitchen, preventing ultrafine lipid aerosol plumes from migrating into living/sleeping quarters.

title: Substitute Incense Sticks (Agarbatti) and Mosquito Coils During Winter

sources.title: Emission of fine particles and carcinogenic polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons from incense burning
sources.organisation: Bulletin of Environmental Contamination and Toxicology

effectModel: Burning 1 incense stick emits 8,000–12,000 µg of PM2.5, which can spike bedroom concentrations above 250 µg/m³ in under 30 minutes.

title: Install Door-Bottom Draught Excluders / Sweeps
appliesWhen: Main entry doors facing outdoor corridors or stairwells

sources.title: Air leakage and infiltration control in multi-family residential buildings

effectModel: Seals the 10–20 mm gap at the door base, cutting infiltration airflow from unconditioned hallways by 40%.

title: Run Purifier on Continuous Low/Auto Rather Than On/Off Cycles
appliesWhen: Sealed room during sustained multi-day smog episodes

sources.title: Operational strategies for portable air cleaners in residential settings

effectModel: Maintains low baseline PM2.5 steady-state; turning off purifiers causes indoor levels to re-equilibrate with outdoor infiltration within 45–60 minutes.

title: Attach Certified PM2.5 Filter Mesh to Split-AC Indoor Units
appliesWhen: Households without dedicated standalone air purifiers

sources.title: Field evaluation of retrofit electrostatically charged filters in residential air handlers

effectModel: Leverages the existing 400–600 m³/h AC fan to filter ~50–65% of recirculating PM2.5 without motor strain.

title: Ensure Vacuum Cleaners Use Sealed HEPA Exhaust Filters
effectModel: Non-HEPA vacuums act as aerosol generators, capturing coarse lint but blowing sub-micron dust directly into the air.

title: Check Bathroom Gravity Louvers & Backdraft Dampers
appliesWhen: Exhaust ducts connected to shared building ventilation shafts
effectModel: Prevents cold, particulate-laden outdoor air from back-drafting through passive vents when exhaust fans are off.
